dependency_setup.command: make update; git -C lib/macos_arm64 lfs checkout
dependency_setup.result: The pinned macOS arm64 submodule was initialized and all 622 current Git LFS objects (approximately 1.1 GB) were materialized.

cpu_build.runtime: build-tetcage-cpu-clang/bin/cycles --list-devices reports CPU on Apple M1 Max
cpu_build.note: The install phase emitted non-fatal install_name_tool duplicate/missing rpath diagnostics; the build-tree executable and upstream CTest are functional.

blender.dirty_root_cause: The checkout had no Git index, so every tracked path appeared as a staged deletion; all 6755 absent worktree paths were Git LFS objects, and the GitHub mirror does not serve Blender's LFS payloads.
blender.recovery: Rebuilt the index from HEAD without overwriting worktree files, restored pointer placeholders, used Blender's official projects.blender.org LFS fallback, initialized the pinned macOS arm64 library submodule, and hydrated the required objects.

claim_boundary: This proves pinned macOS dependency hydration, a standalone Cycles CPU build and upstream test, and a Blender developer/debug UI configure. It does not prove a full Blender build, renderer integration, MetalRT, OptiX, or device performance.
